summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, attaching a press release announcing its Q1 2026 financial results. The filing reports record production of 1,875,375 oz silver and 11,740 oz gold, record revenue of $209.7 million, and mine operating cash flow of $114.6 million. It also notes the completed sale of the Bolañitos mine on January 15, 2026, with a $35.6 million gain. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine quarterly results announcement.
